general_information.name: IT’S INGRID SOLBERG.
general_information.gender: I think it’s recorded as female, but if you need the exact wording I can say it another way.

current_concerns.primary_problems: My mood drops every winter, with oversleeping and craving carbs. It’s been like that for about six years, and I’m in the fourth month of it right now.
current_concerns.goals: I’m hoping for something to help, I think — maybe to get me through the winter a bit better. What exactly do you need for that?

past_psychiatric_history.previous_diagnoses: Yes — major depressive disorder with seasonal pattern.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yes — I had cognitive behavioural therapy.; In 2022, I think.; About 10 sessions, maybe.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_treatments: Yes, I’ve done bright light therapy.; During the winters since 2022.; At home.; Most mornings, I think.; It lasted through the season.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born in Oslo and moved to Toronto when I was 11. I had kind of an outdoorsy childhood, I guess.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I got through school and an architecture degree without any real difficulty, nothing major to report there.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m married — it’s been about 8 years, and it’s current.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to keep working through the winter months without losing ground.
